item.title: Israel launches ‘preventive’ missile attacks against Iran: Here is what we know so far
item.description: Israel on Saturday launched missile strikes on Iran. The Defence Minister of the country called them preventive strikes. Israel sounded sirens across the country, which the military described as a preemptive step to prepare people for a possible retaliatory attack from Iran.
